quranTranslation.text: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.

explanation.bs: „Pa onaj ko očekuje da će sresti svoga Gospodara, neka radi dobro djelo“ – nada koja vodi djelu.
explanation.en: “Whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work” — hope that leads to deeds.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who believe, and those who emigrate (to escape the persecution) and strive in the way of Allah, these have hope of Allah's mercy. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „…takvi se nadaju milosti Allahovoj“ – nada vjernika nakon truda.
explanation.en: “…these have hope of Allah's mercy” — the believers' hope after effort.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! those who expect not the meeting with Us but desire the life of the world and feel secure therein, and those who are neglectful of Our revelations,

explanation.bs: „Oni koji se ne nadaju da će Nas sresti i koji su zadovoljni životom na ovom svijetu…“ – odsustvo nade kao poricanje (neki mufesiri: ‚ne boje se‘).
explanation.en: “Those who expect not the meeting with Us but desire the life of the world…” — no hope, as denial (some mufassirun: ‘do not fear’).

quranTranslation.text: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „i od Koga žudim da mi na Dan suda oprosti moju grešku“ – hvalevrijedna žudnja.
explanation.en: Abraham: “And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment” — praiseworthy longing.

quranTranslation.text: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?

explanation.bs: „Zar svaki čovjek među njima žudi da ga uvedu u Džennet pun blagodati?“ – žudnja bez osnova.
explanation.en: “Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?” — groundless longing.

quranTranslation.text: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.

explanation.bs: „…pa da ne zažudi onaj u čijem je srcu bolest“ – žudnja iz bolesti srca.
explanation.en: “…lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you)” — longing from a sick heart.

quranTranslation.text: Such then is Allah, your rightful Lord. After the Truth what is there saving error? How then are ye turned away!

explanation.bs: „Eto, to vam je Allah, vaš Gospodar, Istina (رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ). Pa šta ostaje nakon istine osim zablude?“ – ar-Rāġib: الْحَقّ kao Allahovo ime.
explanation.en: “Such then is Allah, your rightful Lord (رَبُّكُمُ الْحَقُّ). After the Truth what is there saving error?” — ar-Rāġib: الْحَقّ as a name of Allah.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who appointed the sun a splendour and the moon a light, and measured for her stages, that ye might know the number of the years, and the reckoning. Allah created not (all) that save in truth. He detaileth the revelations for people who have knowledge.

explanation.bs: Sunce i Mjesec – „Allah to nije stvorio osim s istinom (بِالْحَقِّ)“ – ar-Rāġib: Allahovo djelo je istina jer je po mudrosti.
explanation.en: The sun and the moon — “Allah created not (all) that save in truth (بِالْحَقِّ)” — ar-Rāġib: Allah's work is truth, for it is by wisdom.

quranTranslation.text: And they ask thee to inform them (saying): Is it true? Say: Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true, and ye cannot escape.

explanation.bs: „Je li to istina?“ – „Da, tako mi moga Gospodara, to je zaista istina“ – o Sudnjem danu; ar-Rāġib i ovaj ajet navodi.
explanation.en: “Is it true?” — “Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true” — of the Day of Judgement; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah too.

quranTranslation.text: That He may ask the loyal of their loyalty. And He hath prepared a painful doom for the unfaithful.

explanation.bs: „Da upita iskrene o njihovoj iskrenosti“ – ar-Rāġib: onaj ko je iskren jezikom biva pitan za iskrenost svog djela.
explanation.en: He will ask the truthful (الصَّادِقِينَ) about their truthfulness (عَن صِدْقِهِمْ) — ar-Rāġib: one truthful in tongue is asked about the truth of his deeds.

quranTranslation.text: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful.

explanation.bs: „A onaj ko donese istinu (بِالصِّدْقِ) i potvrdi je“ – ar-Rāġib: potvrdio je djelom ono što je donio riječju.
explanation.en: “And whoso bringeth the truth (بِالصِّدْقِ) and believeth therein” — ar-Rāġib: he made good in deed what he brought in word.

quranTranslation.text: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

explanation.bs: Ibrahimova dova: „I podari mi istinit spomen (لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ) među kasnijim naraštajima“ – ar-Rāġib: da pohvala njemu ne bude laž.
explanation.en: Abraham's prayer: “And give unto me a good report (لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ) in later generations” — ar-Rāġib: that the praise of him not be false.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

explanation.bs: „Poranite ka svojim njivama (حَرْث), ako hoćete ubrati plodove“ – obrađena zemlja; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Run unto your field (حَرْث) if ye would pluck (the fruit)” — the tilled land; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso desireth the harvest of the Hereafter, We give him increase in its harvest. And whoso desireth the harvest of the world, We give him thereof, and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: „Ko želi njivu (حَرْث) ahireta, Mi ćemo mu njegovu njivu povećati“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, ono što rad donese.
explanation.en: “Whoso desireth the harvest (حَرْث) of the Hereafter, We give him increase in its harvest” — according to ar-Rāġib, what labour yields.

quranTranslation.text: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

explanation.bs: Davud i Sulejman sude o njivi (حَرْث) u koju su noću zalutale tuđe ovce.
explanation.en: David and Solomon judge concerning the tilth (حَرْث) into which other people's sheep had strayed by night.

quranTranslation.text: Have they not seen how We lead the water to the barren land and therewith bring forth crops whereof their cattle eat, and they themselves? Will they not then see?

explanation.bs: „…kako Mi tjeramo vodu na suhu zemlju i njome izvodimo usjev (زَرْع)“ – nicanje je Allahovo djelo; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “How We lead the water to the barren land and therewith bring forth crops (زَرْع)” — the growing is Allah's act; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

explanation.bs: Faraonovi ljudi ostavili su „i usjeve (زُرُوع) i plemenita mjesta“ – množina, koju ar-Rāġib također navodi.
explanation.en: Pharaoh's people left behind “the cornlands (زُرُوع) and the goodly sites” — the plural, which ar-Rāġib also cites.

quranTranslation.text: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Ja sam, zaista, nastanio dio svoga potomstva u dolini bez usjeva (زَرْع)“ – zemlja na kojoj ništa ne raste.
explanation.en: Abraham: “Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley (غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ)” — land where nothing grows.

quranTranslation.text: Say: If your fathers, and your sons, and your brethren, and your wives, and your tribe, and the wealth ye have acquired, and merchandise for which ye fear that there will no sale, and dwellings ye desire are dearer to you than Allah and His messenger and striving in His way: then wait till Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: „Ako vaši očevi, sinovi, braća, supruge i vaša rodbina … budu vam draži od Allaha i Njegova Poslanika …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “If your fathers, and your sons, and your brethren, and your wives, and your tribe … are dearer to you than Allah and His messenger …” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's party who are the successful?

explanation.bs: Vjernici ne vole one koji se protive Allahu, „pa makar to bili njihovi očevi ili sinovi, njihova braća ili njihova rodbina“.
explanation.en: Believers do not love those who oppose Allah, “even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan”.

quranTranslation.text: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,

explanation.bs: „I upozori svoju najbližu rodbinu.“
explanation.en: “And warn thy tribe of near kindred.”

quranTranslation.text: They said: O Shu'eyb! We understand not much of that thou tellest, and lo! we do behold thee weak among us. But for thy family, we should have stoned thee, for thou art not strong against us.

explanation.bs: „Da nije tvoje porodice, mi bismo te kamenovali, a ti kod nas nisi cijenjen“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But for thy family, we should have stoned thee, for thou art not strong against us” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He said: O my people! Is my family more to be honoured by you than Allah? and ye put Him behind you, neglected! Lo! my Lord surroundeth what ye do.

explanation.bs: Šuajb: „Narode moj, zar vam je do moje porodice više stalo nego do Allaha?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Shuʿayb: “O my people! Is my family more to be honoured by you than Allah?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And his kin that harboured him

explanation.bs: „i najuži rod svoj, koji mu je pružao zaklon“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And his kin that harboured him” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Obilata je dobrota Onoga u Čijoj je ruci vlast, i On nad svime ima moć“ – ar-Rāġib navodi formulu ‚wa-huwa ʿalā kulli šayʾin qadīr‘; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things [qadīr]” — ar-Rāġib cites the formula ‘wa-huwa ʿalā kulli šayʾin qadīr’; as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful.

explanation.bs: „… ili im daje i dječake i djevojčice, a koga hoće učini neplodnim – On je Sveznajući, Svemoćni“ – Svemoćni uz Sveznajućeg, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “… and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful [qadīr]” — the All-Powerful beside the All-Knowing, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?

explanation.bs: „Pa zar Taj nije kadar oživjeti mrtve?“ – moć na nešto određeno; o Allahu, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?” — power over something named; of Allah, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: The similitude of the life of the world is only as water which We send down from the sky, then the earth's growth of that which men and cattle eat mingleth with it till, when the earth hath taken on her ornaments and is embellished, and her people deem that they are masters of her, Our commandment cometh by night or by day and We make it as reaped corn as if it had not flourished yesterday. Thus do we expound the revelations for people who reflect.

explanation.bs: „… a njeni stanovnici pomisle da su njome ovladali, dođe joj Naša odredba noću ili danju …“ – ljudi koji misle da su kadri: particip o ljudima.
explanation.en: “… and her people deem that they are masters of her, Our commandment cometh by night or by day” — people who think themselves able: the participle of people.

quranTranslation.text: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

explanation.bs: „Poricali su sve Naše znakove, pa smo ih zgrabili kako zgrabi Silni i Moćni“ – kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful [muqtadir]” — as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

explanation.bs: „… na sjedištu istine, kod Vladara pune moći“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za muqtadir; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty [muqtadir] King” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for muqtadir; as befits Him.
